event_id.description: RFC 1.2: [E-###] is MUST on every line, always -- phase names are not a substitute. This schema left it out of `required` until v7.101.0, which contradicted the RFC in the one file held up as the machine-readable description of a LOG line.

content.description: TAXONOMY text. No length cap: STYLE.md's commentary voice wraps around the skeleton and routinely runs long. A maxLength of 120 stood here until v7.101.0 and declared 54 of this repo's own 72 live LOG lines invalid, the longest being 501 characters.
